notes: Raw profile was captured at ~1.35x device scaling, so sizes read as 12.6/21.6/81/108px etc.; normalized back to a clean ratio scale (body ~16-18px; lead-in ~21.6px=1.35rem; display 81px=5rem and 108px=6.75rem). Palette is pure two-tone: white page + a single near-black 'stage' (rgb(22,22,22), reported as #161616) used for the projects/footer panel; rgb(136,136,136)=#888 is the only muted grey (captions/labels). Accent is the black itself — there is NO chromatic accent; color in cards comes from project imagery only. radius set is bimodal: 18px (cards) and 1000px/9999px (pills) plus 72px (curled stage corners). No box-shadows anywhere — depth is implied by the imagery and the dark panel, not elevation. Signature easing is cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) (a strong overshoot-free ease-out) at 0.8-1.2s for scroll reveals, with cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0,1) for snappier state changes; reduced from the noisy multi-prop transition strings in raw. weight 300 is rare (a few large headings); 400 dominates; 700 used sparsely (~12 nodes). MOTION: kept the full captured duration set (200-1200ms); the 15000ms value is the continuous contact-badge spin, not a transition. Stack is hand-rolled (no GSAP/Lenis/Framer/Three; 0 canvas, 0 IntersectionObserver) — 'in-view' triggers are scroll-listener-driven (10 scroll + 9 mousemove listeners, 2137 rAF/scroll pass). 5 @keyframes (cb-fx-rotating-360 = badge, cb-btn_menu-open-* = hamburger). reduced_motion is NOT respected (prmRules:0); the morphing cursor + scroll math are the main-thread cost. Cursor technique grounded in probe counts + the cb-cursor matrix, not the frames (per-frame pointer morph isn't visible in stills).
